tasks.short: Read assignment details from consignment notes

steps.what: Locate the current bills of lading for the assigned load
Read bills of lading and establish the actual assignment details

tasks.design: Configure a load-linked consignment view in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The driver still reads the actual requirements and checks that the note belongs to the assigned load; this is no automatic acceptance or signature.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current consignment notes can be separated from the driver's assignment view.
tasks.enabler_now: Native load-document links avoid repeated attachment searches.
tasks.still_hard: Special handling notes and mismatched load details need the driver's attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the actual assignment differs from the paperwork.

ambition.what: Responsibility for understanding the load stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: load-linked document views can reduce attachment retrieval without replacing the driver's reading of consignment requirements.

assumptions: Boundary is actual retrieval and reading, not issuing or signing a consignment note. No reading log is invented.

Transport planning supplies assignment id and load id; the shipper produces the consignment document and version. The driver checks the match in s2. Paper-only or missing notes are read manually, with exception repair funded below.

Ten of twenty-five retrieval units are repeated attachment navigation; fifteen remain for locating and checking the actual document. Existing electronic note runtime earns no new saving. Shares are illustrative, not measured.
unknowns: How often a shipper supplies paper only
research_questions: Does the linked view reliably show the current note for the actual load?

already_counted.description: Retrieve and read the actual note and check its assignment match

incremental.description: Repair missing or stale load-document links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 less upkeep1 gives9. If an unfamiliar shipper sends a paper note, retrieval retains24 of25 and reading75; gross1 less upkeep1 gives0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report vehicle incidents and defects accurately

steps.what: Inspect the vehicle defect or incident circumstances
Capture actual vehicle incident observations and supporting photos
Write the vehicle defect or incident report from the actual observations

loop.input: Driver's captured observations and vehicle identifiers
loop.output: Draft distinguishing direct observations from uncertainty
loop.check: Driver checks event sequence, defect location, severity and every asserted fact against actual observations; photos are evidence, not an automatic diagnosis
loop.stop: Missing facts or uncertain severity require manual writing; one redraft maximum
loop.why_not_simpler: Incident descriptions vary and cannot all be filled from fixed identifiers

steps.what: Check the final vehicle report and exact recipient before sending
Send the checked vehicle report to the designated internal recipient
Save the vehicle report in the existing incident record

tasks.design: Use the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} incident form and vehicle identifiers before adding a bounded draft from the driver's actual notes. The driver checks the meaning and final destination before a separate send; an ordinary save has no approval gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drivers rewrite their observed facts into the formal incident form.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained draft can reuse captured observations while retaining source-based human review.
tasks.still_hard: Urgency, safe continuation and accurate incident facts need actual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a dangerous condition and report uncertainty honestly.

ambition.what: The driver gains no authority to diagnose repairs or release the vehicle.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded draft from actual driver notes can shorten report writing, but defect severity and factual meaning need human review.

assumptions: Boundary is an actual internal incident report used by maintenance or transport management. Immediate emergency calls, statutory external notification and vehicle-release decisions retain their real routes and are not replaced by the report.

The driver produces observations in s1 and captures notes and photos in s2; the vehicle register supplies vehicle id. No free transcript or clean incident feed is assumed. Any extra capture or repair is funded as incremental work.

s3 retains twenty-seven of forty-five writing units for checking and correction. s5 is a real delivery of the report to another role, not a renamed save. Native delivery already present earns no saving.
The exact report and destination exist before s4. Any changed facts, attachments or recipient void its send authorization. Save time is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Whether report writing repeats separate notes today
Actual urgent and external reporting routes
research_questions: Does the draft preserve uncertainty rather than infer a cause?

already_counted.description: Inspect, capture observations, review report meaning, check final delivery and save

incremental.description: Extra capture, difficult draft repair, failed delivery and form upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact incident report, supporting photos and internal recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R78 gross22 less upkeep4 gives18. With ambiguous damage and a largely rewritten narrative, report writing retains42 of45; observation25, capture10, final check15 and save1 remain. R93 gross7 less upkeep4 gives3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Collect the existing delivery instructions from the assignment documents
Clarify delivery instructions with the appropriate site or planner
Enter the actual clarified delivery instructions in the existing job note
Verify delivery instructions and routes against the vehicle and current access conditions

tasks.design: Link current site instructions to the assignment in {OPS_SYSTEM} and reuse stable job references in the existing working note. The driver clarifies uncertain details and checks the delivery approach using the vehicle-routing tool {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Site instructions and working delivery notes are separate from assignment references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and field reuse remove repeated navigation and stable identifier entry.
tasks.still_hard: The actual gate, access restriction or unloading arrangement can differ from the document.
tasks.human_edge: Ask the right clarifying question and reject an unsafe approach.

ambition.what: The driver keeps responsibility for verifying the approach.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: job-linked delivery instructions can reduce search and repeated identifiers while current access verification remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual instruction collection, clarification, working note and route verification. The note is used by the driver during the delivery, not an invented visit report. No shipment acceptance or new send is promised.

Planning supplies job id and site reference; the consignee supplies access and delivery instructions. The driver captures changed facts in s3 and verifies them in s4. Missing site metadata is read from original documents or clarified by phone.

s1 removes five units of source navigation. s3 removes three units of repeated job and address identifiers, retaining twelve for actual instruction writing and checking; negligible same-system save is unchanged and ungated. Native routing runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Whether the driver actually maintains a working job note
How current the site instructions are
research_questions: Can source dates remain visible beside linked site instructions?

already_counted.description: Read instructions, clarify facts, write changed instructions and verify the approach

incremental.description: Repair stale site references and note defaults

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gross8 less upkeep2 gives6. At an unfamiliar site with unstructured access notes, source reading retains23 of25 and note writing15 of15; clarification25 and verification35 remain. R98 gross2 less upkeep2 gives0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interpret maps for a suitable vehicle route

steps.what: Read maps and current route information for the destination
Compare map route candidates with the truck's basic dimensional restrictions
Interpret maps and route constraints to determine a suitable vehicle route

tasks.design: Configure destination links and the correct vehicle profile in the truck-routing tool {OTHER}. The driver still interprets map information, current restrictions and the final local approach before selecting a route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Generic map views make the driver repeatedly locate the destination and reject obviously unsuitable candidates.
tasks.enabler_now: Native vehicle profiles and destination links remove repeated filtering without requiring a model.
tasks.still_hard: Published maps can miss temporary restrictions, actual clearance or a difficult final approach.
tasks.human_edge: Relate the map to the real truck and conditions and stop when access is unsafe.

ambition.what: The driver retains route and driving responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: truck profiles can filter route candidates, but map interpretation and current physical restrictions remain the driver's responsibility.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing truck map and navigation tool. Boundary is map reading and route selection, not driving or a new route report.

Planning supplies the destination; fleet administration supplies current height, width, length, weight and relevant vehicle restrictions. Map providers supply dated road restrictions. The driver checks missing or stale values manually within retained steps; no fresh road sensor feed is assumed.

s1 removes three units of destination navigation; s2 removes five units of rejecting candidates that the actual vehicle profile can exclude. Twenty units of candidate reading and all fifty-five of local interpretation remain.
Where the existing tool already applies the profile, its runtime earns no new labour benefit. Test native settings first. No same-system save or record baseline is invented.
unknowns: Whether the correct truck profile is already configured
Coverage of local and temporary restrictions
research_questions: Does the profile exclude unsuitable candidates without hiding uncertain restrictions?

already_counted.description: Read current maps, inspect candidates and judge the suitable route

incremental.description: Maintain vehicle profiles and repair destination links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R92 gross8 minus upkeep2 gives6. With a changed trailer and temporary restrictions absent from map metadata, source work20 and candidate review23 of25 remain, plus interpretation55. R98 gross2 less upkeep2 gives0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The driver keeps reading, physical assessment and route judgement, with less repeated retrieval and incident report rewriting.
role.ambitious_version: Use recovered clerical time for careful access verification while keeping dispatch and vehicle authority unchanged.
